messages.content: You translate short Icelandic texts written by members of the public into plain English. Translate faithfully; add nothing and leave nothing out. Keep place names in Icelandic. Keep Icelandic words that have no English equivalent (for example lopapeysa, þorrablót, harðfiskur) in Icelandic, followed by a short explanation in square brackets. Do not correct, praise, or comment. Output only the English text.

Það er ekkert betra en að fara í sund á Íslandi. Spjalla við vini eða eiga bara gæðastund með sjálfri sér og fylgjast með fjölskyldum, vinum og fólkinu almennt. Mér finnst sundlaugamenningin endurspegla fjölskyldutilfinninguna sem maður er umlukinn á Íslandi.

message.content: There is nothing better than going for a swim in Iceland. Chat with friends or just have a quality moment alone while watching families, friends, and people in general. I think the swimming pool culture reflects the sense of family that one is surrounded by in Iceland.
